title: What the people inside the school say about it
description: Statements from our Principal and Head Mistress on the standard the institution holds itself to.
note: Parent and alumni testimonials are collected each session by the school office and published here with permission.

items.quote: We feel proud to provide quality education, equipping our students with skills, confidence and a positive approach, with all-round development.
items.name: Ms. Vinita V. Bower
items.role: Principal, New Apostolic English High School & Dr. Bower Apostolic Junior College

items.quote: The school differentiates itself from others through its philosophy of creating an all-round personality. It aims to nurture young minds and see them grow into good citizens of our country.
items.name: Dr. Vandana P. Benjamin
items.role: Head Mistress, New Apostolic English School

items.quote: We are a school with a difference. We value individualism, creativity and innovation, and we strive to nurture them in our students.
items.name: The Management
